_about: Trackable paths for links in letters, posts and listings. Cloudflare Web Analytics drops query strings, so every channel gets its own path. /hi/<channel>/<lang>/ forwards to the homepage in that language; /get/<channel>/<lang>/ forwards to the App Store. Add a channel here (lowercase, a-z 0-9 and -), run python3 scripts/build_outreach_links.py, commit. One channel per letter type, and one per club or outlet that posts about Aera.
